svg.title: Which campaign measured what, on which code
svg.desc: A timeline of 22 October to 2 November 2026, UTC, a bar for each campaign from its first run's start to its last run's end, with what it measured, its rounds and samples, and the code it ran: W2, every arm an operator can deploy, once each, 23 October 00:13 to 08:59, one run a point, one sample, on code before v0.1; W3–W4, the headline configurations, the lifecycle policy and the change, 23 October 10:57 to 24 October 01:35, 5 rounds, one sample, on code before v0.1; W5, the fixed make-room and the configuration to deploy, 24 October 18:56 to 25 October 09:57, 18 rounds, 5 samples, on code after v0.3; FB, the configuration to deploy on the code of 25 October, 25 October 12:47 to 15:22, 5 rounds, 5 samples, on code after v0.3; the A100 run, the main comparison like for like on an A100, 26 October 04:42 to 09:05, 5 rounds and its arms, 5 samples, on v1.0; RS, how often two calls find KV short, 26 October 20:11 to 21:57, 5 rounds, 5 samples, on v1.2; SW, the step cap, the threshold and the window, screened, 27 October 20:56 to 28 October 00:10, one run a setting, one sample, on v1.5; RG, two cards' arrangements, and the step cap confirmed, 28 October 01:41 to 13:19, 5 rounds, 5 samples, on code after v1.6; the soak, the arrangement to deploy, serving for a day, 28 October 15:20 to 29 October 17:24, 2 hours of voice alone, then 24 hours serving, on code after v1.6; OR, the serving engine's additions against v1.14's configuration, 2 November 00:32 to 08:18, 5 rounds, 5 samples, on code after v1.14; OS, the decode hold and speculative decoding on the four additions, 2 November 08:21 to 11:46, 2 rounds, 2 samples, on code after v1.14.
